sentences.text: **Scheme Brief Description:** The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to students from Classes 1 to 8 studying in all government & government-aided schools for purchasing shoes & bags. An amount of ₹318/- per student for Classes 1 to 5 & ₹462/- per student for Classes 6 to 8 is provided through Direct Benefit Transfer.
**Who is this for:** Individual; Category: Education & Learning; Sector: Resources for schools

**Detailed Description:** The scheme &quot;Free Shoes and Bags Scheme&quot; is implemented by the Basic Education Department under the Department of Education, Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to students from Classes 1 to 8 studying in all government and government-aided schools for purchasing shoes and bags.

**Benefits / Assistance:** Under this scheme, financial assistance is provided for purchasing shoes and bags for boys and girls as follows: - ₹318/- per student for Classes 1 to 5 - ₹462/- per student for Classes 6 to 8 The amount is transferred directly to the students&#39; account through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT).

**Application Process:** - Students will receive the amount after submitting their Aadhaar card and bank account details to the Principal. - At the beginning of the academic session, the amount is transferred through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT).
**Contacts & Authorities:** Implementing agency: Basic Education Department, Government Of Uttarakhand; Nodal Department: Department Of Education
